description: This file defines a Flutter widget screen for OTP validation and user authentication, including social sign-in buttons and a phone number input, with testing bypass functionality.

classes.name: OTPValidationScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides user interface for OTP validation and social login options.

classes.name: _OTPValidationScreenState
classes.description: State class implementing the logic and UI for OTPValidationScreen, including social login buttons, phone input, and bypass testing method.

methods.name: _buildSocialButton
methods.description: Helper method to create styled social sign-in buttons.

methods.name: _onContinueTap
methods.description: Handles tap events on the Continue button, including triple-tap bypass trigger.

methods.name: _bypassLoginForTesting
methods.description: Method to bypass login flow for testing purposes, setting preferences and navigating to home.

methods.name: _onContinueWithPhone
methods.description: Validates phone input and navigates to OTPSecondScreen for phone authentication.

methods.name: _onGoogleSignIn
methods.description: Simulates Google Sign-In by setting preferences and navigating to HomeActivity.
